data.body: AC amendment (gap analysis 1/6): Add Function URL auth-type assertion. Per epic d2f9, Function URL is 'public POST endpoint (no API Gateway; built-in HTTPS)' → MUST be --auth-type NONE. Default AWS-CLI safer-default is AWS_IAM which would break universal endpoint contract. Add to t_function_url_no_api_gateway OR new t_function_url_auth_type_none: capture create-function-url-config args via FN_URL_CONFIG_ARG_FILE stub-capture; assert '--auth-type NONE' present. Mirror task-2: grep -qE '--auth-type[[:space:]]+NONE' aws-setup-lambda.sh
